title: Turn on Do Not Disturb
aliases: how do i turn on do not disturb
quiet my phone for a while
help me switch on do not disturb
phone par disturb mat karo mode lagao

steps.instruction: Swipe down from the top-right corner of the screen.
Tap "Do Not Disturb" if it is not already on.

source_note: Control Centre on Face ID iPhones with iOS 26/27, English, October 2026 documentation review. Assumes no other Focus is active; an active Focus shows its own name instead of Focus. Home button iPhones open Control Centre with an upward swipe from the bottom. Allowed people, apps and alarms may still alert you. Not checked on a phone. Source: https://support.apple.com/en-gb/105112
